component.name: org.nuxeo.audit.advanced.blob.test.vocabularyTemplate
component.documentation:
Test-only. Supplies the "template-vocabulary" directory template, which the platform ships in org.nuxeo.ecm.default.config - a bundle no runtime feature used here pulls in. Without it the eventTypes directory of org.nuxeo.ecm.platform.audit never registers, and TestAuditEventTypeRegistration would have nothing to assert against.
Copied verbatim from nuxeo-platform-default-config/OSGI-INF/nxdirectories-contrib.xml; "template-directory" itself comes from SQLDirectoryFeature.
